request.notes: Same code as r5-bias2-003 on the fed-vortex world (128^2, pseudo-spectral, 250 native steps per tick, float64, jax.vmap; GPU throughput unmeasured, so the simulation times its second burn-in chunk, drops training-only trajectories if both halves would not fit in 35 min, and aborts at once if even the minimum would miss the 50-min stop). Training stops starting configs 107 min after start, certification 115 min; worst case 2.05 h. Public parameters, no exam secret. No network or subprocess calls after setup. CPU smoke test passed: job.sh end to end at tiny size (B5_TINY=1) from a git archive of exactly these paths at the code commit 6537dbe92. Expected about 1.3 h.
request.purpose: Round-5 study bias2 (track 1): inductive-bias grid on raw level 0 of the fed-vortex world (vorticity, fuel, two labels; nothing conserved); encoders N/L/U x halo 0/8 x width 1/2 x recon/closure/local law, 2 seeds, cross-fitted, certified by the fixed family
request.setup:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH
uv venv -q -p 3.12 $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv && . $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -q 'jax[cuda12]==0.12.0.1' numpy==2.5.4 scipy==1.18.0
